subject: general
question: Where was the 14th edition of the India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA-2025 conducted?
solution:
The Correct answer is **Chennai**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA** is conducted to strengthen **maritime cooperation** and enhance interoperability between the navies of both nations.
 
• The 14th edition of the bilateral naval exercise INDRA-2025 between India and Russia was conducted in Chennai.**​**
 
• INDRA-2025 included various activities such as **anti-submarine warfare, surface and air combat exercises, and search-and-rescue operations.**
 
• 
 It is a bilateral naval exercise conducted regularly since 2003. 
 
 
• 
 It aims to counter maritime threats, promote global peace and stability, and strengthen joint operations.
 
 
• 
 It reaffirms India-Russia defence ties, enhances collective maritime security, and underscores India’s commitment to a rules-based maritime order. 
 
 
• The exercise reflects the growing **defence partnership** between India and Russia, which spans decades and includes joint naval drills, arms trade, and strategic collaborations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chennai**__

 __
 
• **Chennai** is the capital city of **Tamil Nadu** and hosts the **Southern Naval Command.**
 
• The city is significant for maritime activities and houses major ports like **Chennai Port** and **Ennore Port.**
 
 
 
• **Kochi**__
 __
 
• **Kochi**, located in the state of **Kerala**, is home to the **Southern Naval Command Headquarters.**
 
• It is known for its naval base and the **Cochin Shipyard**, which is a leading shipbuilding facility in India.
 
• Kochi is a hub for maritime defense activities but was not selected for INDRA-2025.
 
 
 
• **Mumbai**__
 
 
• **Mumbai**, the capital city of **Maharashtra**, houses the **Western Naval Command Headquarters.**
 
• It is India's largest port city and has significant maritime infrastructure, including the **Naval Dockyard.**
 
• Despite its strategic importance, it was not the venue for INDRA-2025.
